title: Implementation of the Graphic Rating Scale in Determining Motorcycle Indent Priorities at Motorcycle Dealers
subtitle: Implementasi Graphic Rating Scale Dalam Menentukan Prioritas Indent Motor Pada Dealer Sepeda Motor
abstract: PT Cheger Motor, an authorised Honda motorcycle dealer in South Tangerang, handled indent (pre-order) sales through manual ledgers and WhatsApp, leading to booking delays, lost records and redundant data. This research develops an integrated information system that stores and manages indent orders and calculates a priority value for each transaction using the Graphic Rating Scale method, so the dealer can rank the queue against defined criteria.
citation: Permana, D. R. A., Fahrulrozi, M., Ismono, A., & Ningrum, R. T. (2024). Implementasi Graphic Rating Scale dalam menentukan prioritas indent motor pada dealer sepeda motor. Technomedia Journal, 9(1).
